items.title: Scaling Git at OpenAI
items.en_oneliner: Pando is OpenAI's new Git-compatible backend, built to handle the volume of development that Codex unlocks.

items.title: Introducing the Grid Protectors Program
items.en_oneliner: OpenAI's Grid Protectors Program will team up with utilities so future compute campuses help keep the grid reliable and protect what residents pay for electricity.

items.title: Livestream: Scaling Agentic Development With Air Governance
items.en_title: Livestream: Scaling Agentic Development With Air Governance
items.en_oneliner: JetBrains previews a November 18 livestream on scaling agentic development with Air Governance.

items.title: LifeVal
items.en_oneliner: LifeVal is OpenAI's new benchmark for gauging how well AI helps with everyday tasks — finding childcare, managing finances, handling government paperwork, and the like.

items.title: moonshotai/Kimi-K3.1-Pro
items.en_oneliner: Kimi's new open-weight multimodal model, listed on November 2, with a context window of one million tokens and over 50,000 downloads.

items.title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
items.en_title: Qodo builds context into AI code review with Codex
items.en_oneliner: Qodo feeds company knowledge and coding standards into Codex, so developers can spot cross-repo P0 issues before they even open a pull request.

items.title: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
items.en_title: OpenAI appoints Dan Driscoll as Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization
items.en_oneliner: Dan Driscoll is joining OpenAI as an advisor on responsible AI — covering national security modernization, cyber resilience, and cooperation with US allies.
